steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Take this! Ha! Nice, good job!
Several people work together to restrain the sand beasts, while Hella delivers a powerful blow with her pipe, knocking them down for good.

Behind them, the Aurum Secretum shield generator has been activated, creating a relatively safe perimeter for the wounded. The sand beasts blocking the retreat path are gradually being cleared. If this keeps up, everyone should at least be able to fall back to the caverns for shelter...
As Hella's mind races for a solution, she suddenly senses something wrong. The ever-present howl of the wind, somehow, has stopped.
[Transition, screen shakes]
A massive shockwave slams into Furor, shaking the entire city, knocking Hella to the ground, and completely tearing open the breach overhead.

The next moment, a vast torrent of black sand pours into Furor, blotting out the sky and sunlight. A cyclone churns above everyone's heads, and with sinister whispers, an enormous shadow slowly materializes and descends toward them.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ?! Is that... an Apostle of Ashes?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hey! Have you got any spare Aurum Secretum weapons?!

steps.speaker: Taric
steps.content: We do, but...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Get everything you've got! This thing is no joke. Bring out all your secret weapons now, or we're all dead meat!
The townies frantically haul out an Aurum Secretum cannon. Unlike the intricate shield generator, this weapon is just one smooth barrel with a mysterious crystal embedded in its base.
Hella has no time to notice the grave expressions on their faces. She simply urges them to work together to fire the cannon.
Boom!

steps.speaker: Apostle of Ashes?
steps.content: ...!
The massive recoil knocks Hella to the ground. A huge hole is blasted through the Apostle's form, but the gap doesn't last long before being filled by black particles swirling in the wind.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: It's self-repairing! Quick, we gotta strike while the iron's hot. Fire again!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...Old Rosse? Taric?
No one answers. Hella turns around only to find collapsed Furorians scattering all over the ground behind her.

They're all trembling, with energy visibly soaking its way up their arms, eroding them. That's when she realizes why they hadn't brought out the Aurum Secretum weapon earlier. They can't withstand the impact of using it!

steps.speaker: Taric
steps.content: Cough, cough... It's okay, we can manage... another shot...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Are you mad?! Look at the state you're in after just one shot... You can't handle another. It'll kill you!

steps.speaker: Taric
steps.content: Must protect... the lab... and Aurum Secretum... Leave this to us... You go back... quickly... Run...!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: No way! Aurum Secretum is no use now and Horo isn't here. There's no other option... I'll distract the Apostle while you guys run!
The Furorians struggle to their feet, determined to fire another shot.
A storm is brewing, with the Apostle's attack imminent. Frantic with panic, Hella forcibly yanks the boy away from the Aurum Secretum cannon. But almost simultaneously, her worst fears come true.
—From within the black vortex, an invisible gaze turns toward the two figures locked in struggle.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Damn it!
[Black Screen]
Shh... Don't move.
Something streaks past her at high speed. It collides with the Apostle's attack, erupting into a thunderous explosion in front of Hella.
[CG - Hypatia First Encounter A]

As Hella opens her eyes again, the dark clouds have dispersed, replaced by brilliant radiance. Golden runes encircle Hella's body. The golden rose insignia on the girl's shoulder unfolds petal by petal, transforming into a weapon in her hand.
You... do not belong here.
Formations unfold, completely suppressing the rampaging Mania. At this moment, the jade-green crystal before the girl's palm begins to glow softly, gathering energy...
Begone, return to your lair. You have no place here.
[Transition for 1s, Aurum Secretum resonating sound effect]

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...Hypatia?
[CG - Hypatia First Encounter B]
Hearing the voice from her side, the girl turns her gaze toward Hella.
Hmm...? You are...
[Background: City Center]
The dark silhouette within the magnetic storm grows agitated, emitting a piercing screech as it transforms windborne debris into sharp spikes that hurtle toward the blonde girl standing below.
Now, go!
Numerous uniformed figures appear on the rocky walls surrounding Furor. The Aurum Secretum devices in their hands resonate with the girl's weapon, forming a ring that nearly covers all of Furor.

Boom! An enormous energy beam, far exceeding the power of the Aurum Secretum cannon, fires forth. The dark silhouette is shredded by the light, dissolving into sand particles escaping from the city through the rift.
The crisis seems to have passed. Hella stares in stunned silence at everything that just happened, and at the girl standing not far away.

steps.speaker: Lab Staff
steps.content: Lady Hypatia.
Several researchers have already made their way to the lower part of the city, gathering around Hypatia.

steps.speaker: Lab Staff
steps.content: We're currently tallying the casualties. Multiple anchor points on the outer rock face have failed, severely compromising the barrier. Given how this may affect our ongoing project schedule, we should mobilize the whole city to prioritize repairing the barrier...
But Hypatia simply raises her hand, cutting the conversation short.

She approaches an injured person lying among the rubble. Gruesome wounds cover the victim's body, with infection spreading from the right arm across the entire chest. Despite trying to cover her mouth, the woman can't suppress the broken gasps rattling from her lungs.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Careful... easy now. Don't move, you're injured.
Hypatia kneels down gently, ignoring how her long robe is touching the ash-covered ground. She carefully places her hand over the wound on the injured woman's right arm, emitting a soft blue light.

steps.speaker: Furorian
steps.content: Is this... a Hypercube? No, it's far too precious to be wasted on someone like me!
Hypatia shakes her head. The Hypercube absorbs the Mania from the wound, and color gradually returns to the woman's face. Hypatia stands up and begins giving instructions to the other lab staff.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Let the injured rest. I can handle a few broken anchor points myself.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Tend to the wounded first, then repair those damaged caverns. There might still be Corruptors lurking in the city. Search thoroughly and eliminate every last one.

The crowd stirs and swarms around Hypatia to express their gratitude. Hella stands transfixed, staring at the slender girl not far from her. Though the crisis has subsided with the Apostle of Ashes' retreat, her heart still pounds violently in her ears.
That was her first time seeing Aurum Secretum in its full glory. Intricate and powerful. The Campbell heir completely dominated the Apostle, driving it away with overwhelming force.
Now, that metallic hovering weapon is resting on Hypatia's chest again, transformed back into an exquisite shoulder insignia.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: That Campbell girl... is truly something...
...If I got my hands on Aurum Secretum, could I become that powerful too someday?
Lost in these thoughts, Hella looks up suddenly to find herself making direct eye contact with the girl at the center of the crowd.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...Oh crap! I was supposed to slip away while they were distracted!
Having received their orders, the researchers have already dispersed throughout the city. Only Hella remains in Hypatia's sight. Her gaze is piercing, as if trying to see through Hella's disguise.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: You over there, please stay. I have a few questions for you.
The crowd parts to create a path for Hypatia. Hella finds herself gently ushered forward by the well-meaning throng to meet their most revered Fraser scholar.

steps.speaker: Furorian
steps.content: This is the young girl we rescued from the DisCity people today! She was captured and almost got sold by those scum!
Hella's body freezes as she watches the legendary Lady Campbell making her way through the crowd toward her, one deliberate step at a time.

steps.speaker: Furorian
steps.content: That's right! She saved a few lives during the fight just now too!
Hypatia's penetrating gaze seems to see right through Hella's panic and nervousness as she draws closer. Someone gently pats Hella's shoulder, nudging her frozen body forward.

steps.speaker: Furorian
steps.content: Hella? Hella?
Struggling to control her expression, Hella looks up to find Hypatia already standing right in front of her.
But... unexpectedly, Hypatia merely takes Hella's wrist. A rather bloody scrape lies there, though with Hella's power, it'll heal soon enough.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Um... I-it's nothing, just a small scratch. It'll heal on its own soon... Ah!
Hypatia suddenly tightens her grip. She steps forward, pulling Hella away from the crowd, then leans in close to her ear to deliver the impactful sentence.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Drop your pretense. I know where you're really from...

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: <color=#fb9259>DisCity</color>.
[Background: City Center]

A crowbar shoots out at an angle, followed immediately by a young girl in a Legionnaire uniform. The prison gate has already been warped from the earlier attack, allowing her to pry open the lock with minimal effort.
Horo scans her surroundings vigilantly. With no guards in sight, this is the perfect moment to make their escape.

steps.speaker: Legion Member
steps.content: Horo, should we make a run for it now?

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: ...No, wait a bit longer.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: Take care of the wounded and stay ready. If possible, try to get in touch with Hella. She might be able to gather different intel from inside.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: As for the rest... we'll discuss it after we regroup.

Horo turns around slowly and gazes into the cell. The rocky wall cracked during the earlier quakes, revealing a hidden secret. There lies a concealed passage with a long stone staircase descending into darkness.

A sense of foreboding rings alarm bells in her mind. She hesitates for a few seconds, then steps into the tunnel anyway, advancing into the darkness against the bone-chilling cold emanating from the rift.
...The last time she ventured underground, her family was still by her side. But this time, she's entirely alone.
In a dark corner unnoticed by the Legion, a coin is flipped into the air, spinning several times before being snatched by a hidden observer.
The woman emerges from the shadows, gazing thoughtfully in the direction where Horo has disappeared.
A new visitor... from DisCity?
